_note: The farm itself: ground, buildings and field come from FarmGrid, so this file only adds the ways out. The gate cells are fence cells left open in the drawing; walking into them goes to the village. The farm was widened to 64 x 48 on 2026-11-01 (FarmGrid.W / H): the yard stays in the top left, the field and a woodlot in the far corner (FarmGrid.WOODLOT) fill the rest, and the gate is in the top fence right of the pond, so the walk to the village is no longer than before. Its props are only the story ones (StoryProps), gated by a flag; a solid one blocks its cells for the farmer, the dog and throws, and nothing is farmed under it (FarmGrid.prop_blocks), so the bell on the house wall is not solid: Hachiro's iron door bell by the house door once hachiro_bell is set (heart_hachiro_5); it rings when examined. Hachiro's lumber left of the house's front, by the fence, while a house extension is under way (house_work, Game.BUILD_FLAG); he hammers at the wall from the cell right of its top end and fetches boards from its side (data/villagers/hachiro.json building). Kota's carp streamer stands on its pole at the front left of the house by the fence, below the lumber's place, once kota_streamer is set (heart_kota_6).
name: Farm

props.message: Hachiro's iron bell rings out over the farm.
Planed boards, stacked to keep dry. Hachiro's saw rests on top.
